troubleshooting.solution: Set Axis menu explicitly to X, Y, or Z instead of Auto.
Disable Auto Pivot and set Pivot X/Y/Z manually.
Reverse the input line strip direction (swap first/last point order).

description: Generates a surface of revolution from any set of line strips. Points are swept around a chosen axis (Auto, X, Y, Z) to create a mesh. Each line strip generates its own surface. Supports quads, triangles, line strips, and point connectivity.
